answer: Random beacon audit with a compute heartbeat blocks bulk fake identities. Each epoch the beacon picks 5% of agents; each picked agent must in 10 minutes send a machine-signed heartbeat matching 20 epochs of work. Trust, a terrace built one epoch at a time, cannot be bought. Faking 100 identities costs 100 x 20 units plus 100 live machines, like reshaping a dune or settling a tundra without roads. Honest agents pay once and earn undiluted rewards.
